segments.name: Defense/IT Portfolio
segments.description: Owns, operates and develops office and data center shell properties near key U.S. Government defense installations for the USG and defense contractors.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, our Defense/IT Portfolio included: • 201 operating properties totaling 23.2 million square feet.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds six office properties in the Greater Washington, DC/Baltimore region that the company intends to sell when market conditions permit.
segments.evidence: our Other segment included our remaining six operating properties, representing 7.9% of our square feet in operations.

revenueModel.text: The company earns rental revenue from tenants, primarily the USG and defense contractors, under leases on its office and data center shell properties.
revenueModel.evidence: Our tenants include the USG and its defense contractors, who are primarily engaged in priority national security activities, and who generally require mission-critical and high security property enhancements.
